releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.0-alpha.11 (alpha)
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.0-alpha.11**: every split floats as a glass card, and a first look at the phone app.

- **Glass cards.** Each pane of a split is its own rounded card, lifted off
  the window and edged with a rim of light; the one with the keyboard glows
  in your accent. The gaps between cards are the dividers, with a grip that
  shows under the pointer. The confirm bar and notices are frosted over the
  terminal behind them.
- **Learn the keys where you are.** Hovering + Terminal or + Session shows
  the shortcut that does the same. **Keyboard Shortcuts: Essentials** in the
  palette lists the handful worth learning first, and a new install offers
  it once.
- **No more stuck "Opening…".** A pane that lost its connection to the
  terminal behind it opens again on its own, instead of waiting for you to
  switch away and back.
- **Screen readers.** Settings reads out its switches, choices and text
  size, every icon button has a name, and reopening the window with a
  screen reader running no longer crashes the app.
- **The phone app, early.** `--phone` opens Phux Rune as a phone: the
  terminal edge to edge, glass controls over it, tabs, an accessory bar with
  Ctrl, Option, Shift and an arrow pad, and an on-screen keyboard. It runs
  in a phone-sized window for now, ahead of Rune on phones; on macOS,
  `open -a "Phux Rune" --args --phone`.
- **The latest Rune.** Smoother scrolling and native touch input.

releases.name: desktop: v0.55.0
releases.body:
## [0.55.0](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/compare/desktop-v0.54.1...desktop-v0.55.0) (2026-11-05)


### Features

* **client,desktop:** document streams reach clients, and the desktop draws a surface pane ([#1973](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/issues/1973)) ([0496a28](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/0496a280a7e971141d280b9fdbf6dd81ffc23462))
* **protocol:** admit a client with no Terminal profile; refuse Terminal streams at bind ([#1950](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/issues/1950)) ([db78fc4](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/db78fc43aa3b06dac0f67ee31fddf56863e54bc8))

Desktop: Developer ID signed and Apple-notarized.

macOS: download phux-desktop-0.55.0-macos-arm64.dmg, open it, and drag Phux.app onto Applications. The ZIP is for automatic updates. Apple silicon macOS 26 or later; Ubuntu 24.04 GNU/Linux x64 and arm64 (X11 and Wayland; release qualification uses X11 with lavapipe). Recent DMGs include the phux CLI and server; older releases may require the separate CLI installer (https://phux.sh/install). Existing CLIs and running sessions are not replaced.

Windows x64: native desktop, WSL coordinator.

Install with the per-user PowerShell installer: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/no-phux/phux/main/scripts/install-desktop-windows.ps1 . The portable ZIP includes the same installer and the MSVC runtime. Requires an initialized WSL distribution with phux; signature verification requires minisign on Windows PATH or in WSL.
